176-4875-8249.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4875-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager.
Repeat.

803-5413-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-5413-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability, giving Trenching Steed +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.

When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Repeat.

4036-4398-6668.easyPrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in your graveyard or own an exiled card that has flashback.
4036-4398-6668.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling Seething Song and causing you to cast a copy of it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Sorceress's Schemes either from your hand by paying {3}{R} or from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {4}{R}.
Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling Sorceress's Schemes and causing you to cast a copy of it and Seething Song without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the copy of Sorceress's Schemes, returning the original Sorceress's Schemes from exile to your hand and adding {R}.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

Repeat.

997-4484-4871-5643-6556.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
997-4484-4871-5643-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
997-4484-4871-5643-6556.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
997-4484-4871-5643-6556.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

You control a creature with power 5 or greater.

Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.

When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.

1856-2292-6249--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and the ability granted to it by Doom Weaver each trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Doom Weaver's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, repairing it and the persist creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

372-961-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-4477.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

117-185-2501-3098-3617.manaNeeded: {1}{U} on the first turn, with at most {4}{U}{U} available each other extra turn
117-185-2501-3098-3617.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
117-185-2501-3098-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater, targeting yourself.
Time Walk's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Time Walk trigger, copying it, targeting yourself.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Time Walks, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your last extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Time Walk.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Time Walk and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Time Walk.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Time Walk and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 7.

215-2404-3464-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Forensic Researcher does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
215-2404-3464-5475.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Forensic Researcher any number of times.
